_about: Verification of the nine rewritten sentences against live USDA FoodData Central records (31 Oct / 1 Nov 2026).
reference: 18 mg iron (NIH ODS Iron fact sheet, updated 4 Sep 2025, Table 1: RDA women 19-50 = 18 mg, men 8 mg; read 1 Nov 2026)
note: NIH ODS Table 2 rounds iron to whole mg (lentils and spinach, half a cup: 3 mg = 17%); the sentences use the unrounded USDA value (3.30 and 3.21 mg = 18%).

rows.before: Mussels are a rich source of iron (about 32% of the daily value per serving) and protein, so we highlight them during menstruation.
rows.after: Mussels are a rich source of iron (about 32% of the daily value in 3 ounces cooked) and protein.
checks: stated iron percent = iron in serving / 18 mg
"rich source" means 20% or more of the Daily Value (FDA)
